newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Hermis active on bearish Lithuania bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hermis active on bearish Lithuania bourse.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange saw low activity on Monday and sentiment was bearish for the week ahead, dealers said.
The turnover on the central market of Vilnius bourse amounted to 331,000 litas on Monday.
"I am not totally pesimistic but the market today was very inactive," Grazhina Bachiuliene, broker with Vilfima brokerage, told Reuters.
Hermis Bank made up one third of the turnover on the central market, with dealers expecting good demand for the stock.
"Hermis Bank was relatively active today and the demand for its shares is likely to remain. Taking into consideration its good results, the price is good," Bachiuliene said.
Hermis' shares were unchanged at 180 litas both on the central market and in block trades. Its turnover on the central market was 98,000 litas and 31,000 litas in blocks.
"Other shares gave little reason for surprise and this trend is likely to remain for the rest of the week," Bachiuliene said.
The Lithuanian Sea Shipping company dipped 6.58 litas from 6.60 litas on turnover of 66,000 litas.
Pharmaceutical producer Sema was unchanged at 6.75 litas on 68,000 litas turnover.
Lithuanian Gas edged up to 1.72 litas from 1.7 litas on turnover 5,486 litas.
Government T-bills were not traded on Monday, the bourse said.
